wrapper_rules: Call the complete original function first with RCX/RDX/R8 and Win64 nonvolatiles preserved.
Retain original RDX string[] only in an unwind-described wrapper stack/nonvolatile slot for the duration of the original call.
After normal return pass the retained string[] in RCX to the named helper export.
The helper requires its initialized main thread, validates the complete response synchronously against the current PS4Info singleton and advances only on the exact success shape.
The helper retains no response, element, account, session, UI or Persistency pointer.
Use strict original-byte guards against the exact fully composed GameAssembly base; resolve the already pinned sibling helper without per-callback LoadLibrary.
Both validated counters must advance after arm before purchase state may be classified. Normal early returns for false token or wrong GUID are not generations.
